function.arguments: {"finding": "The trial was not randomised, and treatment assignment is confounded with severity: control arm has more mild patients and fewer severe ones than treatment arm. This is a critical confounder, but the question only asks about a single arm (control) and a single severity level (moderate), so the confounding is not relevant to the estimand. The estimand is conditional on both arm and severity, so we are not comparing across arms or severity levels. Thus, no adjustment is needed.", "implication": "The analysis can proceed as planned, without stratification or modelling for severity or arm. The question is about a subset of the data where both arm and severity are fixed."}
function.name: note_finding
